meta.title: Leadcard
meta.description: Mobile-first live leaderboard for disc golf tournaments.
meta.tournamentDescription: Follow live disc golf tournament standings for {{name}} at {{course}} on Leadcard.

app.name: Leadcard
app.title: Live standings
app.tagline: Spectator-first leaderboard focused on movement, leaders, and the latest meaningful update.
app.liveUpdatesHint: Live scores update automatically. No manual refresh needed.
app.nearLiveDescription: Scores are scraped and diffed on an interval, so updates reflect the latest visible scoring state rather than shot-by-shot tracking.

board.noLeaderboard: No published leaderboard is available yet for this tournament.
board.tournamentHint: Choose the tournament to show on the board.
board.footer: Board mode rotates through divisions and keeps the currently published standings visible for office and TV screens.

tournaments.heading: Tournaments
tournaments.subheading: Active events from one week back to one week ahead.

clubs.title: Club overview
clubs.description: Follow clubs and see their players across every tournament with published results.
clubs.empty: Follow a club above to see its tournament weekend.

snapshot.heading: Global snapshot
snapshot.liveScoringNotAvailableYet: {{roundLabel}} · Live scoring is not available yet
snapshot.upcomingMessage: This tournament is upcoming. Leadcard will switch to live standings once the organizer publishes livescoring.
snapshot.unavailableMessage: Live scoring is not available for this tournament right now.

leaderboard.searchHint: Filters players across all divisions as you type.
leaderboard.noLiveData: This tournament has not started live scoring yet. Check back closer to tee time.
leaderboard.noLiveScoring: Live scoring is not available for this tournament right now.
leaderboard.noFollowedPlayers: No followed players in this division yet.
leaderboard.noPlayers: No players available for this division.
leaderboard.footer: Latest visible scoring state. Through values reflect the most recently published hole, not live shot tracking.

updates.heading: Recent updates
updates.description: The heartbeat of the tournament, inferred from leaderboard movement.
updates.tapHint: Tap any update to jump to that player.
